narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The town is ten, the school is eight thousand, so ten divided by eight thousand.
<bookmark mark='tiny'/>That answer is tiny, as if the town were smaller than the school.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Ten counts square kilometres and eight thousand counts square metres, so they cannot be divided.
